title: CitFix run_events.jsonl row
description: One JSON object per line under runs/<PRODUCT>/<run_id>/logs/run_events.jsonl. Authority: docs/citfix-logging.md.

bug_id.description: Bug id or empty for batch-only events

stage_id.description: Pipeline stage id or empty for run-level events

event.description: e.g. run_start, stage_start, stage_end, stage_blocked, stage_error, gate_fail, agent_stage_enter, nudge, escalate

refs.description: Optional structured pointers (paths, exit_code, validation_errors, duration_ms). Must not contain secrets.
